The adoption rate R(t) reflects a logistic growth curve, capturing both initial rapid expansion and eventual saturation. Pedagogical knowledge transfer K is a function of institutional receptivity P, forming a kernel of influence. Athletic development D(t) evolves as a deterministic trajectory through skill space, governed by cumulative training inputs. The interplay between these three primitives creates a feedback loop: increased adoption drives better instruction, which enhances development pipelines, further incentivizing institutional participation. Failure modes include institutional resistance (P → 0), stagnation in development (D(t) plateau), and loss of cultural momentum (R(t) decline).
